/app/serverless.yml.serviceRawFile:
service: authentication

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: us-east-1
  stage: dev

  environment:
    NODE_ENV: development
    FRONTEND_LOCAL_EVEREST: ${env:FRONTEND_LOCAL_EVEREST}
    JWT_PRIVATE_KEY: ${env:JWT_PRIVATE_KEY}
    JWT_PUBLIC_KEY: ${env:JWT_PUBLIC_KEY}
plugins:
  - serverless-offline
  - serverless-dotenv-plugin
custom:
  serverless-offline:
    httpPort: 3333

package:
  patterns:
    - dist/**

functions:
  api:
    handler: dist/src/main.handler
    timeout: 30
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /
          method: ANY
      - httpApi:
          path: /{proxy+}
          method: ANY
